'''CorelliSpace''' was a minor corporate competitor to the [[Corellian Engineering Corporation/Legends|Corellian Engineering Corporation]]. They produced the ambitious but unsuccessful [[Gymsnor series]] [[Light freighter/Legends|light freighters]].
